items.title: Costco Reports Higher Fourth-Quarter Profit, Revenue on Resilient Consumer Spending
items.summary: Costco  Wholesale reported a higher profit and rising sales in its fiscal fourth quarter, citing continued spending from consumers undeterred by sticky inflation.  “Our members continue to show resilience in their spending, and they show a willingness to spend in discretionary areas where they’re seeing exciting new items at great value,” Chief Financial Officer  Gary Millerchip  told investors on a Thursday call.  Chief Executive  Ron Vachris  added that a run-up in gas prices stemming from the war in Iran has boosted the value proposition of Costco’s gas offerings.
